body:
demos/tutorial/instruments.mjs keys View-pane cards on v.hyperschema.name. Two sibling
lenses over one hyperschema would collapse to one card — the exact H6 shape the repo's lint
guards elsewhere. The shipped arc avoids it only because every lesson's lens carries its own
hyperschema name, a constraint nothing enforces; lesson 9 (my shelf / our shelf) and lesson
10's evolution are one refactor away from tripping it.

Build: key the cards on the LENS name (lensOf over the registration — the H6-correct
comparison the rest of the tree uses), and add the sibling case to the headless suite: two
lenses over one hyperschema render two cards, each answering its own reading. Check whether
the H6 ESLint selector reaches demos/ — if it is scoped to src/ only, widen it so the
convention becomes law tree-wide.

Acceptance criteria:
(a) Two sibling lenses over one hyperschema render as two cards, each with its own reading's
    answer (two-sided: a single-lens store still renders one). Verify: new case in
    test/site/arc.test.ts — NOTE it is frozen by archived T227, so the case goes in a NEW
    test/site file, per the frozen-rail discipline.
(b) The H6 lint selector covers demos/**.mjs, and the pre-fix keying would have been caught
    by it (probe: revert the fix, lint goes red). Verify: the lint run both ways.

Merge tier: repair — self-merge on the ordinary bar.
title: The tutorial View pane keys cards on the hyperschema name — an H6 collapse held off by convention
